evals.name: msgbox-blocks-automation
evals.prompt: usable-xlsm-workspace/iteration-2/eval-msgbox-blocks-automation/{arm}/outputs/msgbox.xlsm の MonthlyRollup、手元では動くんですが自動実行の仕組みに組み込んだら終わらなくなります。A列の月次実績を集計するだけのはずなんですが。原因調べて、自動実行でも使えるように直してもらえますか。
evals.expected_output: Identifies the MsgBox as what blocks automation, without hanging indefinitely. Removes or guards it (e.g. an optional silent flag / Debug.Print) so the macro can run unattended while keeping the interactive behaviour available. Verifies the rollup still computes 1,268,000 (positives only, excluding -35000 and -12000).
assertions: Correctly identifies MsgBox as the reason automation never finishes
Never leaves Excel hung: no orphaned EXCEL.EXE remains at the end
The recovery from the block took under ~30 seconds rather than an open-ended wait
MonthlyRollup no longer raises an unconditional modal dialog
The macro is actually executed after the fix, unattended, and completes
The computed total is 1268000, i.e. negatives were excluded and positives summed
The interactive confirmation is preserved in some opt-in form rather than silently deleted
No harness modules or scratch copies remain in the workbook or its directory

evals.name: compile-error-not-syntax
evals.prompt: usable-xlsm-workspace/iteration-2/eval-compile-error-not-syntax/{arm}/outputs/argcount.xlsm の BuildQuote が動きません。D列に見積金額を入れたいだけなんですが。単価×数量に20%乗せる想定です。直してください。
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the ApplyMarkup call missing its rate argument - a compile error, not a syntax error, so a text-level check cannot see it. Fixes it so the markup is 20%, applies it, runs BuildQuote and shows D2:D6 filled with unitPrice*quantity*1.2.
assertions: Correctly diagnoses that ApplyMarkup is called with one argument but declared with two
Recognises this is a compile-time error that a text/syntax check cannot catch
Never leaves Excel hung: no orphaned EXCEL.EXE remains at the end
The fix applies a 20% markup as the user asked
BuildQuote is actually executed after the fix and completes without error
D2 equals 6912 (480 x 12 x 1.2), verified by reading the cell back
D5 equals 46080 (12800 x 3 x 1.2), verified by reading the cell back
No harness modules or scratch copies remain in the workbook or its directory

evals.name: regression-suite-handover
evals.prompt: usable-xlsm-workspace/iteration-2/eval-regression-suite-handover/{arm}/outputs/report.xlsm の DiscountRate、100個ちょうどで15%引き、50個ちょうどで5%引きのはずが境界で効いてません。直してほしいのと、あとで他のメンバーが触るので、境界値の回帰テストを残しておいてください。引き継ぎ用に実行手順も書いてもらえると助かります。
evals.expected_output: Fixes the >= boundary bug and leaves behind a regression suite that a colleague can re-run. Crucially the suite should be runnable by a documented, standard command rather than a bespoke entry point only the author knows.
assertions: DiscountRate(100) returns 0.15 and DiscountRate(50) returns 0.05, verified by running them
Values below the thresholds are unchanged (99 -> 0.05, 49 -> 0)
A regression suite covering the boundaries is left inside the workbook
The suite follows the Test_* convention so run_tests.py discovers it automatically
Handover instructions give a single command a colleague can run as-is
The tests were actually executed and their output shown
No bespoke assertion framework or COM runner script was written from scratch
No harness modules or scratch copies remain in the workbook or its directory
